About Nexlab
‍ Nexlab Technology is a software company of around 20 people based in Ho Chi Minh City, partnering with enterprise clients across healthcare, education, manufacturing, tourism, and commerce. What sets us apart is that we run our entire development process on an AI foundation — and we're looking for people who want to enter the profession the way it will be practiced in the future, rather than relearning the old way of working.If you're curious about how a single engineer can produce output that used to require an entire team, this is a place where you'll experience exactly that, every day.
‍ About the Role
‍ As a Junior Frontend Engineer , you'll own the interface layer for one or two enterprise client projects — from high-performance websites and internal portals to business web applications. Most of the frontend code at Nexlab is generated by an AI coding agent under your direction; your core work is to translate designs and specifications into precise instructions for the agent, then verify the output down to every state.This is a role for people early in their career, and we evaluate you on the quality of your output, not on years of experience. You'll always have a mentor alongside you and a clear review process in the early stages.
‍ How the Team Works — AI-First
‍
The entire pipeline (specification
design
build
testing
release) runs onSpec-Driven Development, Nexlab's in-house methodology: the specification is the single source of truth, the AI coding agent builds to the spec, and humans verify at fixed gates.
Our guiding principle: AI proposes, humans decide.AI can generate a "looks-right" interface very quickly — the person who catches what's actually off in the empty state, the network error, Vietnamese text overflowing a line, or a 360px screen, is you.
The team works onsite so you can learn as fast as possible during the junior stage. We measure delivered outcomes, not hours at the desk.
"Junior" at Nexlab does not mean assembling interfaces from templates. You're given a clearly bounded part of the product and own its quality — with mentor support, mandatory reviews, and the release decision resting with the Technical Lead.
Key responsibility:
Operate the AI coding agent on your assigned interface (primary focus)
‍
Read designs and specs and turn them into fully constrained instructions for the agent: component structure, design tokens, screen states, empty/error behavior, responsive rules.
Maintain project context for the agent: design tokens, existing component libraries, naming conventions, and boundaries to respect.
Break complex screens into steps the agent handles well, rather than building an entire page in a single pass.
‍ Verify the output (the most important part of the role)
‍
Compare the build against the design at both the pixel level and the behavior level: correct tokens and correct spacing — not "close enough."
Check what AI most often misses: loading/empty/error states, long Vietnamese content breaking the layout, keyboard interaction, contrast, and semantic tags.
Review the agent's generated code for unnecessary re-renders, incorrect effect dependencies, memory leaks, and unsafe data handling.
When the agent is systematically wrong, feed the correction back into the project's ruleset instead of patching each instance by hand.
‍ Own the quality of your area
‍
Integrate APIs, handle asynchronous states, and manage client-side data caching.
Take responsibility for measured performance: bundle size and Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS).
Test to a level appropriate to each screen's risk, prioritizing user-flow testing.
Take part in incident handling and write concise root-cause analyses (RCA).
‍ Contribute back to the way we work
‍
Package every effective component, rule, and prompt pattern into shared assets for the team.

You will help build next-generation simulation platforms by combining modern frontend development, real-time 3D visualization, and digital twin technologies.

Khác với vai trò Staff SRE tập trung vào vận hành và tối ưu nền tảng hiện có, Principal SRE sẽ quyết định các chiến lược mang tính nền tảng như lựa chọn kiến trúc đa đám mây, mở rộng sản phẩm sang thị trường mới, tiêu chuẩn bảo mật, quản trị hạ tầng, tuân thủ pháp lý xuyên biên giới và mô hình vận hành cho toàn bộ tổ chức kỹ thuật.
Bạn sẽ là người mà các Staff Engineers, Engineering Managers và lãnh đạo công nghệ tìm đến khi phải giải quyết những bài toán hạ tầng phức tạp nhất, có ảnh hưởng đến nhiều quốc gia, nhiều hệ thống và nhiều đơn vị kinh doanh.
Key Responsibilities
1. Infrastructure Strategy & Platform Architecture
Xây dựng và sở hữu chiến lược hạ tầng dài hạn phục vụ tăng trưởng của GSM trên toàn cầu.
Định hướng kiến trúc cho toàn bộ nền tảng công nghệ, bao gồm chiến lược cloud, roadmap đầu tư nền tảng và các quyết định build-versus-buy.
Chuyển hóa các kế hoạch kinh doanh như mở rộng thị trường, ra mắt sản phẩm mới hoặc M&A thành kế hoạch triển khai hạ tầng khả thi.
Đóng vai trò là chuyên gia kỹ thuật cao nhất trong các quyết định kiến trúc liên quan đến Platform, Security, Compliance và Product Engineering.
2. Multi-Cloud Infrastructure & Governance
Thiết kế và quản trị hệ sinh thái hạ tầng trải rộng trên AWS, Google Cloud Platform và Huawei Cloud .
Xây dựng chiến lược Infrastructure as Code thống nhất bằng Terraform và Policy-as-Code, bảo đảm tính nhất quán giữa các môi trường và nhà cung cấp cloud.
Thiết lập các tiêu chuẩn bảo mật mặc định như Zero Trust, mTLS, WAF, IAM Federation và Identity-Based Access Control.
Dẫn dắt chiến lược hợp tác với các nhà cung cấp cloud lớn nhằm tối ưu hiệu năng, độ ổn định và chi phí vận hành.
Phối hợp với Security, Legal và Compliance để đáp ứng các yêu cầu pháp lý và tiêu chuẩn quốc tế như PCI-DSS, GDPR hoặc các quy định địa phương.
3. Global Kubernetes Platform & Service Mesh
Định hình kiến trúc Kubernetes đa cụm, đa vùng và đa cloud cho toàn bộ tổ chức.
Chuẩn hóa các mô hình triển khai trên EKS, GKE và CCE.
Thiết kế các cơ chế traffic management quy mô lớn thông qua Istio/Envoy bao gồm:
Canary Deployment
Traffic Shifting
Rate Limiting
Cross-Cluster Routing
gRPC Load Balancing
Xây dựng và quản trị các Helm Charts, deployment templates và nền tảng self-service cho các đội ngũ phát triển.
Mentor và nâng cao năng lực cho Staff Engineers, Senior SREs và Platform Engineers.
4. Observability & Incident Readiness
Xây dựng chiến lược quan sát hệ thống hợp nhất bao gồm Metrics, Logs, Traces và Alerting trên toàn bộ hệ sinh thái cloud.
Thiết lập và thúc đẩy áp dụng SLI, SLO và Error Budget cho các dịch vụ trọng yếu như Dispatch, Payments và Order Routing.
Thiết kế mô hình vận hành Follow-the-Sun để đảm bảo khả năng hỗ trợ sự cố 24/7 trên nhiều múi giờ.
Đảm bảo khả năng điều tra nguyên nhân gốc cho các vấn đề sản xuất phức tạp liên quan đến latency, Kafka, database, network và distributed systems.
5. Reliability Engineering & Incident Leadership
Chủ trì các đánh giá kiến trúc cho những thay đổi có mức độ rủi ro cao nhất.
Đóng vai trò Incident Commander cuối cùng trong các sự cố nghiêm trọng ảnh hưởng đến nhiều quốc gia hoặc nhiều cloud provider.
Điều phối xử lý sự cố, truyền thông với các bên liên quan và quản lý quá trình khôi phục dịch vụ.
Xây dựng văn hóa học hỏi sau sự cố thông qua Postmortem, Root Cause Analysis và tự động hóa phòng ngừa tái diễn.
Tối ưu hiệu suất của các hệ thống phân tán quy mô lớn với trọng tâm là latency và system resilience.
6. High Availability & Disaster Recovery
Thiết kế chiến lược HA/DR đa vùng và đa cloud cho:
PostgreSQL
MySQL
Redis
Kafka
Định nghĩa RPO/RTO theo từng nhóm dịch vụ và mức độ quan trọng kinh doanh.
Lãnh đạo các chương trình kiểm thử Disaster Recovery và Chaos Engineering.
Xây dựng kiến trúc dữ liệu xuyên biên giới, đảm bảo cân bằng giữa dữ liệu nội địa hóa và nhu cầu vận hành toàn cầu.
Chuẩn hóa các mô hình caching, throttling, backpressure và scalability cho toàn bộ hệ sinh thái.
7. Capacity Planning & FinOps
Dự báo nhu cầu tài nguyên hạ tầng theo từng thị trường và từng giai đoạn tăng trưởng.
Thiết lập thực hành FinOps cho môi trường multi-cloud.
Tối ưu chi phí thông qua:
Rightsizing
Capacity Reservation
Egress Optimization
Workload Placement
Trình bày các đánh đổi giữa chi phí, hiệu năng và rủi ro cho lãnh đạo công ty bằng ngôn ngữ kinh doanh.
8. Regulatory Compliance & Data Residency
Dẫn dắt việc triển khai các yêu cầu về Data Residency và Cross-Border Data Transfer tại các quốc gia GSM hoạt động.
Thiết kế kiến trúc bảo mật, mã hóa và phân quyền đáp ứng yêu cầu pháp lý theo từng thị trường.
Đại diện cho Platform Engineering trong các cuộc kiểm toán, đánh giá tuân thủ và làm việc với cơ quan quản lý khi cần thiết.
9. New Market Expansion
Đánh giá mức độ sẵn sàng của hạ tầng trước khi mở rộng sang quốc gia mới hoặc triển khai các sản phẩm có yêu cầu quản lý cao như Payments.
Thực hiện technical due diligence về cloud, connectivity và regulatory landscape tại thị trường mục tiêu.
Xác định kiến trúc tối thiểu cần thiết để ra mắt sản phẩm an toàn và có khả năng mở rộng.

Professional English, written and verbal — you'll work closely with our US-based teams.

ABOUT JOB:
We are building the customer support experience inside a retail digital banking app: in-app chat with live agents and virtual assistants, secure messaging, service requests and complaint tracking, transaction and card disputes, document upload, and self service help. These are the journeys customers reach when something has gone wrong, so reliability, security and accessibility matter more here than anywhere else in the app.
You will own the Android side of these features end to end — from API contract discussions with backend and CRM teams through to Play Store release and production monitoring — working closely with the iOS engineer on the same squad to keep behaviour consistent across platforms.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, build and ship customer support features in Kotlin for a production banking app used by a large customer base.
Integrate real-time chat and contact-centre platforms (WebSocket / third-party SDKs such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Genesys, Zendesk, LivePerson or Twilio) and chatbot / AI assistant flows.
Build secure flows for case creation, dispute raising, status tracking, document and image upload, and push-notification-driven deep links back into an open case.
Work with backend and BFF teams to define REST / GraphQL contracts, and handle authentication, session management and token refresh correctly.
Apply mobile security practices expected in banking: Android Keystore, EncryptedSharedPreferences / DataStore, certificate pinning, BiometricPrompt, root and tamper detection, R8 obfuscation, FLAG_SECURE on sensitive screens, OWASP MASVS alignment.
Handle the unhappy paths properly — poor connectivity, session timeout mid-conversation, process death and state restoration, OEM battery optimisation affecting push delivery, retry and offline queueing.
Manage device and OS fragmentation: test across screen sizes, API levels and major OEM skins, and keep up with Play Store target API and privacy policy deadlines.
Write unit and UI tests, participate in code reviews, and keep the module healthy in CI/CD (build, test, sign, distribute to internal testing tracks).
Meet accessibility standards (TalkBack, font scaling, touch target size, contrast) — a regulatory and reputational requirement for banking apps, not an afterthought.
Monitor crash, ANR, performance and funnel analytics after release, and act on what the data shows.
Participate in Agile ceremonies with a distributed team; collaborate with product, design, QA, security and compliance

description_raw:
ABOUT JOB:
We are building the customer support experience inside a retail digital banking app: in-app chat with live agents and virtual assistants, secure messaging, service requests and complaint tracking, transaction and card disputes, document upload, and self service help. These are the journeys customers reach when something has gone wrong, so reliability, security and accessibility matter more here than anywhere else in the app.
You will own the iOS side of these features end to end — from API contract discussions with backend and CRM teams through to App Store release and production monitoring.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, build and ship customer support features in Swift for a production banking app used by a large customer base.
Integrate real-time chat and contact-centre platforms (WebSocket / third-party SDKs such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Genesys, Zendesk, LivePerson or Twilio) and chatbot / AI assistant flows.
Build secure flows for case creation, dispute raising, status tracking, document and image upload, and push-notification-driven deep links back into an open case.
Work with backend and BFF teams to define REST / GraphQL contracts, and handle authentication, session management and token refresh correctly.
Apply mobile security practices expected in banking: Keychain storage, certificate pinning, biometric authentication, jailbreak detection, no sensitive data in logs or screenshots, OWASP MASVS alignment.
Handle the unhappy paths properly — poor connectivity, session timeout mid-conversation, backgrounding during an active chat, retry and offline queueing.
Write unit and UI tests, participate in code reviews, and keep the module healthy in CI/CD (build, test, sign, distribute to TestFlight).
Meet accessibility standards (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, contrast) — a regulatory and reputational requirement for banking apps, not an afterthought.
Monitor crash, performance and funnel analytics after release, and act on what the data shows.
Participate in Agile ceremonies with a distributed team; collaborate with product, design, QA, security and compliance

About Nexlab
‍ Nexlab Technology is a software company of around 30 people based in Ho Chi Minh City, partnering with enterprise clients across healthcare, education, manufacturing, tourism, and commerce. What sets us apart is how we build: our entire development process runs on an AI-first foundation. Because of this, we especially value early-career engineers who are ready to approach the craft with a fresh mindset from day one.
‍ About the Role
‍ As a Junior Mobile Engineer, you will own the mobile application layer of our enterprise client projects — including end-user apps, internal apps, and kiosks. Most of the code here is generated by AI coding agents under your direction; your core mission is to define problems with precision and verify the results on real devices.This role is a great fit for early-career engineers with a strong drive to grow and an orientation toward output quality. We believe capability is proven through delivered results, not merely through years of experience.
‍ I. How We Work — AI-First, AI-Driven
‍ Our entire pipeline — from specification, design, and implementation to testing and release — runs on AI tooling under Spec-Driven Development, Nexlab's internal methodology. The specification is the single source of truth, AI coding agents build against it, and humans verify the output at fixed quality gates.
This model enables a single engineer to produce output that traditional workflows would require an entire team to deliver. For this junior role, we expect productivity to grow along 3 / 6 / 12-month milestones, with specific criteria discussed transparently from your onboarding session.
Because our products serve enterprise clients, every mistake carries a real cost. That is why we hold firmly to one principle: AI proposes, humans decide. For mobile specifically, a faulty build costs more than on the web — it must pass store review, and users don't update instantly. This is precisely why verification discipline is placed front and center in this role.At Nexlab, "junior" does not mean handling only secondary work. From the very start, you'll be given a clearly scoped part of an application and will own its quality — always with a dedicated mentor alongside you and mandatory reviews in place to support your steady growth.
‍ II. Key Responsibilities
Operating AI coding agents on your assigned application scope (core focus)
‍
Study designs and specifications and translate them into fully constrained prompts for the AI coding agent: screen structure, state model, navigation flow, offline behavior, and device-permission handling.
Maintain project context for the agent: the current architecture, the chosen state-management library, naming conventions, and the technical boundaries to respect.
Break features into appropriately sized steps for the agent to execute effectively.
‍ 2. Verifying the output (the most important part of the role)
‍
Verify directly on real devices (both iOS and Android, across a range of screen sizes and OS versions within the supported scope), not just on emulators.
Carefully cover the cases AI tends to miss: connection loss mid-flow, the OS reclaiming app memory, returning from the background after a long time, denied permissions, Vietnamese diacritics rendering, and repeated taps sending duplicate requests.
Review agent-generated code for issues such as memory leaks, unnecessary rebuilds causing dropped frames, sensitive data stored in the wrong place, and improper screen lifecycle handling.
When the agent makes systematic mistakes, proactively update the project rule set rather than fixing each instance manually.
‍ 3. Owning the release lifecycle
‍
Integrate APIs and handle data synchronization and offline state according to project requirements.
Write tests proportional to risk, prioritizing core business flows.
Package the application for the App Store, Google Play, and internal distribution channels; manage certificates, signing profiles, and release notes; and execute releases under the Technical Lead's approval.
Monitor post-release incident reports, resolve them, and produce concise root-cause analyses (RCA) for your area of responsibility.
‍ 4. Contributing back to our shared systems
‍
Distill every effective screen template, rule, and prompt pattern into shared assets that strengthen the whole team's capability.
‍ III. Requirements
‍
Under 2 years of experiencein mobile development; or no professional experience yet but you've independently shipped at least one app to a store or to real users (with a link or installable build to discuss).
Working proficiency in Flutter and Dart:able to build stateful screens, handle navigation, call APIs, and manage errors independently. We also welcome candidates with a React Native or native background who have successfully self-taught and applied a new framework in real work.
Solid understanding of the mobile app lifecycle: when screens are created and destroyed, how state is lost, and why data disappears when returning from the background.
Deep understanding of at least one state-management model (Bloc, Riverpod, Provider, or equivalent) — we value depth over breadth.
An AI-native mindset in daily work: you've used AI coding agents or AI IDEs (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent) in real work. This is a baseline requirement for the role.
A verification mindset for AI output: you can share a specific instance where AI-generated code ran correctly on an emulator but failed on a real device, and how you caught it.
Data-security awareness: you understand and follow the rules on not feeding real client data into AI tools beyond the permitted scope.
Strong ability to read English technical documentation.
‍
A learning mindset: you proactively raise questions when stuck and take ownership of every line of code you deliver.
‍ IV. Nice to Have
‍
A native Android (Kotlin/Java) or iOS (Swift) foundation at the level of reading code and handling platform bridges.
Experience setting up CI/CD pipelines for mobile (GitHub Actions, Codemagic, Fastlane).
Performance-optimization experience: memory leaks, dropped frames, startup time.
Experience with kiosks, kiosk mode, or peripheral hardware integration.
Experience integrating large language models or on-device AI features into an app.
Experience building your own prompt pipelines, skills, or AI workflows for your work.
Strong spoken English (some projects involve working directly with international clients).
Open-source contributions or public technical writing.

Social insurance and statutory benefits in accordance with Vietnamese labor regulations.
Opportunity to work on digital transformation projects within the healthcare sector.
Professional, innovative, and collaborative working environment.
Career development opportunities in healthcare technology and business analysis.
Team-building activities, company events, and annual celebrations.

Requirements
Experience
5+ years building Android apps in Kotlin, shipped to production.
At least 2 years in a codebase where more than one team commits to the same app.
Kotlin and async
Coroutines and Flow in production: structured concurrency, cancellation, scopes, StateFlow vs SharedFlow , cold vs
hot streams, back pressure.
RxJava or RxKotlin in production: Observable vs Flowable , schedulers, disposal, and the common leak causes.
You can convert an Rx chain to Flow and name where the behavior differs.
UI
Jetpack Compose in production: state hoisting, recomposition scope, stability and skipping, remember vs
rememberSaveable , side-effect APIs, Modifier order.
Compose navigation, deep links, and screen-level state that survives process death.
Material 3 theming and a shared design system; layouts that adapt to phone, tablet, and foldable.
Accessibility basics: content description, touch target size, dynamic font scale.
Architecture
Clean Architecture with MVVM or MVI. You can say where a rule belongs — view model, use case, or repository — and defend it.
Unidirectional data flow, explicit UI state model, explicit error model.
Dependency injection with any of Hilt, Dagger 2, Anvil, Koin, or Kodein: scopes, graph shape across modules, and the startup cost of that graph.
Scale
A multi-module codebase: module boundaries, api vs implementation , and how to stop a shared module from
becoming a dumping ground.
Gradle Kotlin DSL and version catalogs; you can read and fix a build file.
Testing as a habit: unit tests for domain logic, fakes over heavy mocks, Compose UI tests on critical paths.
Data
Retrofit or Ktor, OkHttp interceptors, kotlinx.serialization or Moshi.
Local storage with Room or DataStore, plus a cache and offline strategy you can explain.
Strong plus
These separate a good candidate from the one we hire fastest. You do not need all of them.
Build and modularization at scale
Gradle convention plugins, composite builds, KSP, configuration cache, remote build cache.
Dependency-graph rules enforced in CI, not by convention.
Measured build-time work: a number before and after.
Runtime performance
Baseline Profiles and Startup Profiles, Macrobenchmark, Perfetto or the Android Studio profiler.
Cold start, jank and frame timing, memory leaks (LeakCanary), R8 rules, app size and Play delivery.
Reduced ANR rate or crash rate with a named root cause.
Superapp platform work
A host shell with pluggable features: feature registry, entry-point contract, versioned API between host and feature.
Mini-app or partner integration: sandboxing, an API bridge with a permission model, and containment when a plugin misbehaves.
Dynamic feature delivery, remote config, feature flags, staged rollout, kill switch.
SDK or internal library design: source and binary compatibility, deprecation path, migration guide.
Quality engineering
Turbine for Flow tests, Robolectric, screenshot tests (Paparazzi or Roborazzi), macrobenchmark running in CI.
CI/CD for Android: build matrix, signing, release train, automated regression gates.
Nice to have
Kotlin Multiplatform or Compose Multiplatform; shared logic with iOS.
Interop with Flutter or React Native modules inside a native host.
gRPC or protobuf; WebSocket or long-lived connections; real-time sync and conflict handling.
Security work: Android Keystore, encrypted storage, certificate pinning, tamper or root checks, obfuscation. Payment, KYC, or wallet flows.
On-device ML: ML Kit, Gemini Nano, or a similar on-device model.

description_raw: WHAT WE ARE Zeya Labs is a small AI-native engineering team based in Ho Chi Minh City. We are the central technology delivery engine for a diversified group spanning financial services, F&B, retail, hospitality, and real estate. We build shared platform utilities, run AI pilots across group entities, and own the product thinking that makes those things useful rather than merely functional. We are not a consultancy. We do not hand off specifications. We build, run, and own what we ship. We are early. The org is being stood up now. If you need things to be settled before you can do your best work, this probably isn't the right move. WHAT THIS ROLE IS Every group entity generates data on its own terms — different systems, different structures, no shared platform. It's tempting to respond to that with a target-state architecture: map every source, design the ideal schema, build the platform that fixes it once and for all. We are explicitly not doing that. Nobody is commissioning a data platform build here. What actually happens is narrower and more useful: a shared utility or targeted solution gets blocked because the data behind it is messy, fragmented, or locked in a format nobody's cleaned up. This role exists to unblock that — using AI to do in days what used to take a data engineering team a quarter. That's the mindset shift this role needs. Not "what's the correct long-term data model," but "what's the smallest, smartest thing I can point at this mess to make it usable, right now, for the thing that's actually blocked." Sometimes that's an AI agent doing extraction and reconciliation across messy source systems. Sometimes it's a narrow pipeline. Concretely, this role owns three things: Finding the highest-leverage problem, not the biggest one. Not surveying every system the group has. Finding the specific data problem that's actually blocking an AI pilot or shared utility right now, and going after that — not the tidiest or most complete problem, the one that unblocks something real. Using AI to solve the data problem, not just engineering around it. Reaching for AI-native approaches first — agents, LLM-based extraction, matching, and reconciliation — instead of defaulting to hand-built pipelines and manual schema work. This is the advanced-thinking bar: staying current on what AI can now do to a data mess that used to require heavy traditional engineering, and knowing when it genuinely can't and something more conventional is needed. Building toward specific goals. Every fix ties to a specific goal — an AI pilot that's stuck, a utility that needs clean input. No platform roadmap, no multi-quarter build. Ship the narrow thing, move to the next blocker.

description_raw: What This Role Is We are building AI-native products and delivery systems in a space without established playbooks. As AIaugmented engineering and autonomous workflows mature, the core challenge is shifting from building software to orchestrating, refining, and governing intelligent systems that make decisions and execute work. As an AI Product Builder, you will report directly to the Head of AI and product. While the engineering team focuses on deep system design and architecture, you operate at the intersection of product thinking, AI capability, and execution of reality. You are the person who translates ambiguity into structured systems—turning business problems into AIdriven workflows, coordinating across stakeholders, and ensuring what we build is both technically feasible and operationally usable. You will work closely with internal stakeholders on rapid experimentation, prototyping, and Lab-based initiatives that demonstrate and validate new agentic capabilities. This role requires a strong baseline of technical and systems of understanding. You will not be responsible for core architecture or writing production code, but you will actively participate in technical discussions, shape system behavior at the product layer, and help ensure AI systems are correctly aligned with realworld constraints and business outcomes. Concretely, you are responsible for four things 1. AI Product and Design Product Discovery & Framing Break down ambiguous operational problems into structured requirements Identify high-impact opportunities for AI automation and augmentation Rapidly validate ideas through prototyping and iteration Delivery Alignment Work closely with engineering to ensure requirements are executable Define clear acceptance criteria, edge cases, and success metrics Bridge operational needs with technical implementation realities AI-Driven Optimization Identify manual workflows that can be automated or AI-augmented Continuously propose system improvements as tools and models evolve Own the full build lifecycle prototype in the AI Lab, productionize it through internal transformation, and maintain solutions post-deployment with support from engineering and platform teams. Be an active member of the AI Lab, contributing demos and reusable assets and helping build a strong builder community across the firm

Tư vấn yêu cầu và định hướng bảo mật cho các dự án số hóa nghiệp vụ (nền tảng giao dịch số, nền tảng dữ liệu/AI, nền tảng ngân hàng giao dịch…). 2.2. Thiết kế và đánh giá bảo mật Thiết kế, đánh giá kiểm soát bảo mật cho hạ tầng cloud (IAM, network segmentation, mã hóa dữ liệu, quản lý key) theo AWS Well-Architected Framework – trụ cột Security. Thiết kế kiến trúc Zero Trust Network Architecture (theo NIST SP 800-207). Đánh giá bảo mật container/Kubernetes và pipeline CI/CD (SAST, DAST, SCA) phối hợp với đội DevSecOps. Rà soát bảo mật cho nền tảng giao dịch số đa kênh — đặc biệt các cấu phần định danh & xác thực, đăng ký/mở tài khoản, thanh toán, thẻ… — trước khi đưa vào vận hành chính thức. Đánh giá nhu cầu kiểm thử xâm nhập (penetration testing) và đánh giá lỗ hổng (vulnerability assessment) định kỳ cho các hệ thống giao dịch số. 2.3. Xây dựng mô hình vận hành/giám sát SOC (Security Operations Center), hệ thống SIEM để phát hiện và ứng phó sự cố theo mô hình 6 hàm của NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 (Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover). Xây dựng (và diễn tập) kịch bản ứng phó sự cố an ninh mạng, phối hợp kế hoạch khôi phục thảm họa (DR) theo ISO 22301 cho các nền tảng mới. Điều tra, phân tích nguyên nhân gốc (root cause analysis) khi xảy ra sự cố bảo mật hạ tầng và đề xuất biện pháp khắc phục, phòng ngừa tái diễn. 2.4. Quản lý tuân thủ Đảm bảo hạ tầng và ứng dụng tuân thủ Thông tư 09/2020/TT-NHNN về an toàn hệ thống thông tin trong hoạt động ngân hàng, bao gồm yêu cầu quản lý truy cập, kiểm soát tài khoản quản trị và các nguyên tắc khi sử dụng dịch vụ CNTT của bên thứ ba. Tham gia xây dựng và duy trì Hệ thống quản lý an toàn thông tin (ISMS) theo ISO/IEC 27001:2022, hướng tới đạt chứng nhận cho phạm vi hạ tầng cloud và nền tảng số. 2.5. Đào tạo và nhận thức Xây dựng và triển khai chương trình đào tạo nhận thức an ninh mạng định kỳ cho đội phát triển, vận hành và toàn thể nhân viên. Governance, Compliance & Regulatory Alignment Apply IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and CIS Controls pragmatically to an airport OT environment. Operate within Vietnam's regulatory framework for critical information infrastructure: the Law on Cybersecurity, Decree 53, and personal data protection requirements, including reporting relationships with CAAV and the Ministry of Public Security. Integrate OT telemetry into the enterprise SIEM (Splunk-based), and define alert ownership together with the SOC and the operations team. 5. Secure Procurement & Supplier Gating Write capability-based security requirements for OT procurements and assess supplier responses. Operate device compliance questionnaires as procurement gates: protocol conformance, TLS support, authenticated access, safe-state behaviour on loss of communications, and interlock independence. Define proof-of-concept scope and acceptance criteria before any monitoring or enforcement platform is purchased. 6. As MFV grows, we are strengthening the security and governance functions we operate locally. This role expects a strong security mindset, with a clear understanding of data privacy, credential protection, device security, and the responsible use of corporate systems, tools, and accounts. About the CISO Office With the mission “Maximize the value we deliver to customers through security,” the CISO Office defines how security should work across the entire Money Forward group. Excessive security controls can slow development and reduce or delay the value we deliver to customers. As security professionals, we constantly weigh risk and design the security that is genuinely optimal for our customers. Our security principles Embedded security in business strategy — Security is never considered in isolation. We design security measures together with the business strategy: the current business phase, cost, expected future revenue scale, and the potential losses if a risk materializes. Advanced balancing between security and experience — The strongest possible security is not always the right answer, as it raises cost and can harm usability. We assess risk and choose the optimal measures—sometimes taking on risk to pursue maximum user value—and drive automation to reconcile usability and security at a high level. Autonomous and scalable security organization — As the group’s development organization grows, a CISO Office that owns every security function would become a bottleneck. description_raw: Finding something that actually fits online can be frustrating. We're on a mission to change that with AI fit assistance for lingerie and apparel brands: a chat assistant and sizing quizzes that are live on real stores today. We're looking for a Full-Stack Product Engineer to help us scale it. Position Overview We're looking for an experienced Full-Stack Product Engineer to join our team working on our AI fit-assistance platform for lingerie and apparel brands. You'll be responsible for building and owning the client-facing half of Brarista: the integrations that connect us to the tools our clients already run on, the dashboard they live in, the flows that take a new client from signed to live, and the compliance and cost optimisation work that lets us sell to bigger brands and to become cash-positive. If something makes onboarding faster, wins us more clients, or shows clients what Brarista is doing for their revenue, that's yours. We're small and moving fast, and there's a lot of blank paper. You will be the person scaling us up from software that works well on a handful of stores into an operation a non-technical person can roll out to many. → Contractor, full-time. 12 month contract with an initial 6 month trial. → Location: Anywhere in the world → Working timezone: UK 9am - 7pm window → Team: Third engineer, joining two founding engineers and the founder → Ideal starting date: ASAP in late September/mid October. Applications considered on a rolling basis, so apply early. This posting may close early. Job scope: Treat this as a guideline rather than a boundary. We’re a start-up, and everyone joins in when there’s a problem to solve. 1. Integrations - connecting us to the tools our clients already use. Shopify first, including the App we’re building now. Then Gorgias, putting our fit assistant inside the helpdesks our clients’ support teams work in every day. After that, analytics and lifecycle tools, so our data lands where clients already look at their numbers. You’ll help decide what we integrate next, not just build what’s handed to you. 2. Client onboarding efficiency. Bringing a client live currently takes too many manual steps and too much engineering time. Your job is to turn it into a workflow a non-technical person can run start to finish, from signed contract to live widget: catalogue import, size chart setup, brand configuration, testing, go-live. This is the highest-leverage thing you’ll do, and it’s what lets us take on more clients without adding people. 3. The client dashboard, its analytics, and how it makes money. Our dashboard shows clients their funnel, revenue attribution, conversations and quiz insights. You’ll build on that and own the monetisation surface alongside the founder: plans, feature gating, usage metering, AI credits, overage, upgrade flows. Deciding what sits behind the paywall is part of the job, not a decision handed to you. The bar isn’t “does the feature work”, it’s “does this make the value obvious enough that a client upgrades”. 4. Our MCP server. So we can ask questions about client performance in plain English and get live answers, instead of clicking through dashboards. A spec exists; you’ll build it and extend it as our data grows. 5. Compliance that unlocks deals. The bigger the client, the more they ask before signing: security questionnaires, DPAs, data-processing details, evidence we handle their shoppers’ data properly. You’ll own the engineering side of that and the client-facing responses. In practice: building the data export and deletion flows Shopify and GDPR require, keeping our data inventory and sub-processor list current as we add integrations, supporting the ISO 27001 work already in progress, and meeting Shopify’s protected customer data requirements for the App Store launch. When a client’s legal team sends a questionnaire, you answer it, and when the answer is “we don’t do that yet”, you build it. This isn’t a paperwork job. It’s the difference between winning an enterprise client and losing one. 6. Cost and quality as we scale. Every conversation costs us money in AI and infrastructure. Keeping that curve flatter than our revenue curve is what gets us to cash-positive, so you’ll watch what we spend on GCP and MongoDB and engineer it down. Alongside that: automated tests around the logic that matters most, sizing and billing above all, and supporting pen testing when clients ask for it. And running through all of it: you’ll sit in on product feedback sessions with clients alongside the founder, hearing directly what’s confusing, what’s missing, and what they’d pay for. We think engineers build better products when they hear the complaints themselves rather than through a summary.

Ứng phó sự cố: Thực hiện các bước ứng phó ban đầu theo quy trình (playbook), bao gồm việc cô lập hệ thống bị ảnh hưởng, ngăn chặn các hành vi tấn công và thu thập bằng chứng số. Quản lý Lỗ hổng Bảo mật (Vulnerability Management) Quét và nhận diện lỗ hổng: Sử dụng các công cụ chuyên dụng (ví dụ: Nessus, Qualys) để thường xuyên rà quét lỗ hổng trên các hệ thống máy chủ, ứng dụng và thiết bị mạng. Phân tích và xếp hạng rủi ro: Đánh giá mức độ nghiêm trọng của các lỗ hổng được phát hiện, kết hợp với bối cảnh kinh doanh để ưu tiên các hoạt động khắc phục. Tình báo An ninh mạng (Threat Intelligence - TI) Thu thập và phân tích thông tin: Chủ động theo dõi, thu thập thông tin về các mối đe dọa mới, các chiến thuật, kỹ thuật và quy trình (TTPs) của hacker từ các nguồn tin cậy (open-source và thương mại). Tích hợp TI vào vận hành: Áp dụng thông tin tình báo để cải thiện khả năng phòng thủ, ví dụ như cập nhật danh sách các IP độc hại (IOCs) vào Firewall/SIEM, hay triển khai các quy tắc phát hiện mới dựa trên TTPs của các nhóm tấn công đang hoạt động. Săn lùng mối đe dọa (Threat Hunting): Dựa trên giả thuyết và dữ liệu tình báo, chủ động tìm kiếm các dấu hiệu bất thường, các hành vi đáng ngờ chưa bị hệ thống tự động phát hiện. Tuân thủ & Báo cáo (Compliance & Reporting) Phối hợp kiểm toán: Hỗ trợ các hoạt động đánh giá, kiểm toán an ninh nội bộ và bên ngoài (ví dụ: PCI DSS, ISO 27001) bằng cách cung cấp bằng chứng, log và các tài liệu liên quan. Đảm bảo tuân thủ chính sách: Giám sát và thực thi việc tuân thủ các chính sách, quy trình bảo mật đã được ban hành trong toàn tổ chức. Xây dựng báo cáo: Định kỳ tạo các báo cáo về tình hình an ninh, số lượng sự cố, trạng thái lỗ hổng và các chỉ số hiệu suất quan trọng (KPIs) để gửi cho cấp quản lý. Endpoint Security Quản trị và tối ưu hóa các nền tảng EDR/XDR (như CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint). Thiết lập các chính sách ngăn chặn (Prevention policies), loại trừ (Exclusions) và giám sát liên tục. Thực hiện Threat Hunting chủ động trên các thiết bị đầu cuối để phát hiện các hành vi bất thường chưa có chữ ký (signature). DFIR (Digital Forensics & Incident Response) Phản ứng nhanh với các cảnh báo bảo mật mức độ cao. Thực hiện thu thập dữ liệu bộ nhớ (RAM), ổ đĩa và log hệ thống để phân tích pháp chứng. Phân tích mã độc (Malware Analysis) cơ bản để hiểu hành vi và tác động của chúng. Xây dựng báo cáo điều tra sau sự cố (Post-Incident Report) và đề xuất biện pháp khắc phục triệt để.

Xây dựng và duy trì CI/CD pipeline cho việc triển khai hạ tầng và ứng dụng; đảm bảo quy trình deploy an toàn, có thể lặp lại và rollback khi cần. Tự động hóa các tác vụ vận hành định kỳ: provisioning, patching, scaling, configuration management; giảm thiểu thao tác thủ công và rủi ro lỗi người dùng. Duy trì các module, template và chuẩn hạ tầng tái sử dụng; đảm bảo tính nhất quán giữa các môi trường DEV, SIT, UAT và Production. 4. Triển khai mã hóa dữ liệu at-rest và in-transit với KMS, quản lý certificate và xử lý secrets an toàn với Secrets Manager hoặc Parameter Store. Vận hành công cụ bảo mật và governance: GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail, Inspector; xử lý các phát hiện bảo mật trong thời hạn quy định. Hỗ trợ kiểm toán, compliance và các yêu cầu quản lý nhà nước liên quan đến hạ tầng công nghệ của công ty chứng khoán; cung cấp bằng chứng kiểm soát và tài liệu kỹ thuật khi cần. 5. Giám sát, quan sát hệ thống và xử lý sự cố Xây dựng hệ thống monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboard và alerting với CloudWatch kết hợp Prometheus, Grafana hoặc ELK Stack. Định nghĩa và theo dõi SLO/SLA cho các hệ thống quan trọng; đảm bảo hạ tầng đáp ứng cam kết về availability và performance. Thực hiện kiểm tra định kỳ disaster recovery và failover; đảm bảo kế hoạch phục hồi hoạt động đúng theo thiết kế.

Security & Compliance: Embed security best practices across the infrastructure (IAM, least privilege, secrets management, network policies, data protection) and ensure compliance with industry standards and internal governance. Knowledge Sharing & Mentorship: Mentor teammates through code and architecture reviews, and support development teams via reusable patterns, documentation, and self-service capabilities rather than by fielding their questions directly. AI-Assisted Engineering: Leverage GenAI tools and AI agents to accelerate common development and operational work so your time goes to the highest-impact engineering, reviewing and verifying output against production standards for reliability, security, cost, and maintainability, and coach teammates to do the same.

description_raw: The Manager, Business Intelligence & Analytics serves as the dedicated analytical capability powering DKSH's Business Development function, transforming market, tender, account, sales, and industry data into decision-ready intelligence that directly enables commercial growth. In this senior individual contributor role reporting to the Business Development Director, you build and steward repeatable business intelligence assets that equip the Business Development team to identify, assess, and act on high-value opportunities across Vietnam's healthcare and pharmaceutical landscape. What You Will Deliver Build and continuously refresh a structured pipeline of relevant multinational, biotech, and local healthcare companies, products, and portfolios to sustain a robust opportunity target universe. Monitor and synthesize market shifts, product launches, portfolio changes, partner or contract transitions, regulatory and market-access developments, tender signals, and competitor activity to surface timely and actionable opportunity intelligence. Maintain the monthly target tracker and signal watchlist, producing priority scoring, target dossiers, meeting briefs, and opportunity fact packs that enable swift and confident Business Development (BD) decision-making. Conduct quarterly portfolio whitespace reviews by therapy area, channel, category, and service model to identify capability gaps and adjacent growth opportunities. Assess potential assets and partners against criteria including strategic fit, market attractiveness, competitive intensity, access feasibility, portfolio synergy, and cannibalization risk to inform management prioritization. Prepare gap maps, screening scorecards, and evidence-based go/hold/no-go recommendations that support structured management prioritization discussions. Build and maintain a reusable library of market, tender, access, competitor, channel, coverage, and productivity benchmarks that demonstrate DKSH's commercial capabilities to prospective clients. Develop and standardize forecast templates, segmentation frameworks, assumption logs, and reusable proposal modules to improve speed and consistency across the BD team. Strengthen proposal quality by providing source-verified proof points and reconciling key figures across analytical models, presentation slides, and cost assumptions ahead of internal review. Partner with Business Development Managers (BDMs) to translate deal briefs into structured analysis plans, defining the business question, required evidence, data sources, methodology, assumptions, limitations, and timelines. Develop comprehensive fact bases and models encompassing market sizing, tender analysis, competitor mapping, account and channel segmentation, patient and customer funnels, forecasts, scenarios, and sensitivity analysis. Convert analytical outputs into editable models, charts, tables, and appendices ready for BD proposals and management decisions, with clear flagging of risks, data gaps, and confidence levels. Uphold data integrity by applying source indexing, refresh dates, standardized definitions, version control, reconciliation checks, audit trails, and documented assumptions across all analytical products. Protect commercially sensitive information by enforcing need-to-know access protocols, secured deal workspaces, and agreed information classification standards. Collaborate across Analytics and Insights Services (AIS), Finance, Medical, Regulatory, Market Access, Commercial Excellence, Sales, and other functions while maintaining clear accountability boundaries.Administrative duties and coordination tasks as required. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Economics, Business, Finance, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is an advantage. At least 6 years of experience in healthcare or pharmaceutical market intelligence, commercial analytics, business planning, commercial excellence, consulting, or a comparable role; prior experience supporting BD or commercial proposals is preferred. Strong Excel modelling and PowerPoint skills, with practical experience working with market data, internal sales data, tender data, hospital and account data, and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems; proficiency in Power BI or other data visualization tools is an advantage. Demonstrated ability in market sizing, forecasting, scenario analysis, segmentation, competitor analysis, and synthesis of incomplete or inconsistent data. Structured, detail-oriented, and self-directed approach to work, with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively, manage competing deadlines, communicate fluently in both English and Vietnamese, and handle highly confidential information with integrity. Why Join DKSH At DKSH, we help companies grow in Asia and enable people to perform at their best. You will be part of an organization that values accountability, collaboration, and long-term partnerships. We offer a dynamic environment where your contributions are visible and where you can build a meaningful career in Business Development.

Join us if you have the talent and the desire to advance financial access for all by turning data into better decisions. But you own the truth — your real edge is the judgment to validate AI output, catch hallucinations, verify the numbers, and ground every recommendation in the actual data. This role is built for someone who leads the AI, not someone the AI replaces. Design and evaluate experiments — run A/B and other tests to validate hypotheses and turn learnings into repeatable playbooks. Protect quality proactively — detect performance shifts, data-quality issues, funnel breaks, and cohort degradation early, find the root cause, and drive structured follow-ups to resolve them. We expect you to: Use AI/GenAI tools daily to accelerate analysis, generate diagnostic hypotheses, and explain root causes from large, complex datasets. Use AI to brainstorm growth ideas and experiment variants grounded in real behavioral patterns, and to synthesize market and competitor signals. Seeda builds marketing measurement models for consumer brands. We have spent four years making the company AI-first, function by function. Remote, Sydney overlap, full-time, reporting to our Head of Data Platform. These are the real problems, unsolved today, across four live accounts: Radio and TV schedules arrive as one file per station and get retyped by hand. 14,516 rows for one client's radio. Offline bookings arrive as 189 signed PDFs. The agency media plan, the invoice and the platform connector disagree on every number. We found a 20 percent gap that turned out to be fees, eight months in. A confectionery brand tracks retailer promotions in its own format. Get the structure wrong and the model confuses promotion effects with media lift. About 40 percent of rows fall through our channel mapping into a human review queue, and the rulings never get written down. A platform feed expired and nobody noticed for a year. A spend line in a closed period moved overnight. We only know because a person remembered yesterday's number. A revenue export of 58,879 rows arrives with the tagging column reading "Untagged". Our first LLM extraction invented figures on live client work. The rule now: scripts compute, humans judge exceptions, nobody retypes, and no LLM invents a number. You have solved a material share of this somewhere else, with the current agentic stack rather than a chain of prompts, for people who depended on the output. You know where it broke and what you changed. Must have: 1 to 3 years building agentic data pipelines in production for marketing, advertising or sales data. Something you can demo live. Python and SQL you would let us read. Fluent written English. Working day overlapping Sydney hours by at least five. Big advantage: you did this inside a marketing data company, a media agency data team, an ad platform, a retailer's insights function or a measurement vendor. To apply, no cover letter. description_raw: ngay qua LinkedIn Lưu The Job in short The Data Enablement team is here to enable every team in the organisation with their data needs. Our job starts the moment that data enters our platform and ends when it reaches whoever needs it. We are a small, senior team of data and AI engineers, working across customer data, product knowledge, and the data the organisation runs on. We bring data in, reconcile it into one version people can rely on, and make it available to the right audience. Increasingly that audience is agents as well as people, so everything we build has to work for both. Two things must hold at every step: that only the right people can see it, and that we can prove it is correct. The second is where this role sits. As a Senior AI Engineer you own the promise that what we serve is right. You are the leading voice on assurance and evaluation across everything the team delivers, from the source through to the answer someone reads. Product calls this assurance. Engineers call it evaluation. It is the same job. In practice it is two kinds of checks and one framework. Deterministic checks on structure, completeness and freshness. Probabilistic checks on whether a generated answer is grounded and correct, including the judges and the golden datasets behind them. Today those checks exist per project and per tool, built by whoever needed them. You turn them into one configurable framework, reusable across sources, reporting into a single view of platform health. Product knowledge is where it starts, because it is the one journey we run end to end ourselves, from ingesting the source to the answer a customer reads. That framework is the first phase, not the ceiling. Once it is running and trusted, the same judgement applies to everything else we build: retrieval quality, agent behaviour, and the systems that serve them. We are hiring for the authority you bring on assurance and evaluation, because it is the capability that decides how far the rest can go. Meet the job The list below describes the AI Engineer discipline at Backbase. In Data Enablement your first focus is the evaluation and assurance responsibilities that follow. The wider discipline opens up once that foundation is in place. Agentic Orchestration: design and implement complex agentic workflows and assistant platforms using the LangChain ecosystem. Advanced Retrieval: develop and optimise RAG and GraphRAG pipelines to give agents deep, contextual domain knowledge. Calibration: Rate judges against human ratings and measure agreement as true positive and true negative rate. description_raw: You will participate in building the core data foundation for Binance's stock and related financial market businesses, responsible for the full pipeline from data source discovery, evaluation, ingestion, and integration to unified modeling, real-time processing, quality governance, and data services. Beyond completing defined integrations, we expect you to leverage industry expertise to continuously identify better data sources and technical solutions, enabling new markets, products, and data to serve trading products and AI quickly and reliably. Conduct research, technical evaluation, ingestion, integration, cleansing, standardization, computation, storage, and servicing of financial market data, covering securities master data, real-time and historical market data, fundamentals, corporate actions, indices, and business-required product and risk data; responsible for source ingestion, raw retention, and stable delivery to knowledge engineering pipelines for content-type data such as announcements, news, and research reports. Establish data quality and service level frameworks, taking responsibility for completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency, and traceability; build automated reconciliation, anomaly detection, monitoring and alerting, raw data replay, backfill, and fault recovery capabilities. Evaluate different sources (vendors, exchanges, APIs, file feeds, compliance collection) for coverage, quality, stability, revision mechanisms, and technical fit; collaborate with product, procurement, legal, and compliance teams to clarify usage, display, derivative, retention, and redistribution boundaries; drive rational primary/backup source strategies and alternatives. Drive data engineering efficiency and technical quality improvements, including metadata, data lineage, automated testing, CI/CD, task orchestration, capacity governance, and AI-assisted development.
